findings.evidence: The proposed CRM note supplies exact receipt and booking dates although the fictional scenario provides only today/yesterday and no lead time zone. Current source line 45 requires relative treatment when the receipt date or time zone is unknown.
findings.impact: A copied note could record unsupported calendar anchors as business facts. A runtime current date does not establish the lead's receipt-date/time-zone record. No real CRM mutation occurred.
findings.repair: Keep relative labels or explicit receipt/booking-date placeholders in proposed records unless the scenario supplies the necessary calendar anchor and time zone.
findings.retest: Repeat consequential and normal cases on the repaired hash. No absolute receipt or booking date may appear without supplied support. Preserve the existing stop-contact and appointment safeguards.
